lines.speaker: Uncle Sirisena
lines.text: Good! I will set my alarm for 3:30. We will go together.

The notice was false. The EC logo was wrong. The footer was missing. Polling opens at 7am,  always has. Twenty-three people in Alupotha will arrive at 4am. The queue at the Grama Sevaka Office will be longer this week as Nandadasa deals with confused people who came before dawn.
